bronze_arm.name: Bronze arm
bronze_arm.text: The Smiths cast the arm in bronze from the mould of the one it replaced.

bronze_leg.name: Bronze leg
bronze_leg.text: A bronze leg does not float. It never will.

bronze_jaw.name: Bronze jaw
bronze_jaw.text: The jaw is cast shut around what it used to say.

bronze_ribs.name: Bronze ribs
bronze_ribs.text: A cage of bronze where the ribs were. Nothing moves it; nothing in it breathes easily.
